verdict.rationale: AMD provides datacenter-scale infrastructure pieces — GPU Operator for Kubernetes, Cluster Validation Suite, SR-IOV, AI-native Slurm-compatible scheduler (Spur), container toolkit, and 288GB HBM3E/8TB/s memory bandwidth specs — showing rack-scale deployment tooling. However, there is no explicit documentation of GPU-to-GPU interconnect (e.g., Infinity Fabric bandwidth/topology) analogous to NVLink, and independent benchmarks show the MI355X trailing Nvidia's B300 in multi-GPU (TP8) decode throughput, casting some doubt on multi-GPU scaling parity. missing for 10: explicit Infinity Fabric/GPU-interconnect bandwidth specs, first-party multi-node training benchmarks, and independent corroboration of rack-scale training performance at parity with claims.
